description: Web distribution of the stage-C residence x workplace x industry table (2020 census 従業地・通学地集計, 15歳以上就業者, both sexes). graph.json adds graph.workplace; the page fetches only the files of the selected municipality.

graph.workplace.version: model version of workplace_c.npz (every file carries the same value; the page refuses a mismatch)
graph.workplace.files: number of files (2 per leaf municipality)

workplace/o_<code>.json.code: residence municipality (2020 leaf: ward of a designated city, or municipality)
workplace/o_<code>.json.rows: [[workplace code, commuting category 0..3, [20 industry counts, persons rounded to 0.01]], ...] sorted by size; every OD pair published in table 3
workplace/o_<code>.json.unknown: [20] residents with unknown workplace by industry (outside the distribution)
workplace/o_<code>.json.home: residents working at home (inside the own-municipality category; all industries)

page_computation: P(workplace | residence[, industry]) sums the rows (a designated city = union of its wards); a stage-A industry mixture is re-conditioned on a known workplace (w_g (1 - P(unknown|o,g)) renormalised) before mixing P(d|o,g), exactly as persona_v4. The workplace side gives P(residence | workplace[, industry]) for 働きに来る人; it is never labelled 昼間人口.
